column1: # The source-layout round's gate exceptions (docs/source-layout-round.md 7a, the owner's calls 8 and 10): a
# function may differ only in a named class listed here. Classes: inline (x86_64; the compiler
# inlined, or stopped inlining, a moved or copied helper because its callers in the file changed);
# low32-site (x86_64; Low32()'s failure message names another file, line or
# function: __FILE__, __LINE__ and the __builtin_FUNCTION() default argument, which a move or a
# rename of the caller changes); data-layout (both widths, call 10; a promoted variable - or, from stage B, a moved
# one or a moved neighbour - is placed elsewhere in .data/.bss, so a neighbouring file-local and its readers'
# reference to it differ, or a bss extent changes; a row may name a data or bss symbol); x64-indirect (x86_64 only, call 10; a folded internal function pointer is called through
# once external; a row names the caller or the pointer, which reads NEW); i686-fold (both widths, call 16; a promoted
# variable whose value or layout the optimiser had folded into its readers, which now load it; a row may name the
# data or bss symbol or a reader); i686-inline (both widths, call 16; a promoted file-local function the compiler had
# inlined into its callers in the file, now called; a row names the function, which reads NEW, or a caller, or its
# static local); i686-convention (both widths, call 16, the owner 2026-11-09; a promoted file-local function that had a
# body but was called by LLVM's internal register convention, now called as the ABI says; a row names the function,
# a caller, its static local or the moved exception table); refptr (both widths, the owner's call of 2026-11-09 on
# group B1; a moved function reads a global its old file defines, which llvm-mingw's auto-import loads through the
# pointer stub `.refptr.X` once the reader is in another file - one load more, the same symbol; a row names the
# reader, or the `.refptr.` data symbol, which reads NEW). By the same call `inline` reaches i686 for a move (the
# split of a wave file's shared helper changes how many callers each file has). The i686 gate passes
# but for those classes. A new class needs the coordinator's entry in the round doc with its first case. Read by
